image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a disposable plastic lighter lying on a textured black surface with white line-art patterns. The lighter has a translucent blue base and a red mesh-textured body. The top metal guard is visible but slightly out of focus. The background shows blurred greenery and indistinct figures, suggesting an outdoor setting.
